[P1] 宝宝情绪管理图画书
学会承担
“亚马孙·王子”萨米
[法] 佩·瓦克尔/文
[法] 索菲·克南斯/图
党 蔷/译
时代出版传媒股份有限公司

[P2] 宝宝情绪管理图画书
学会承担
“亚马孙王子”萨米
［法］颜·瓦克尔／文
［法］索菲·克南斯／图
党 蔷／译
时代出版传媒股份有限公司
安徽教育出版社

[P3] 出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适当地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适当地，对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期，一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露，就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

[P4] 老师对你说
你甘可以成为“王了”
这是一个形象鲜明、情节夸张的童话故事，它为我们指出了一个重要的，与每个生命都息息相关的话题—环境保护。
小猴萨木住在热带雨林边缘的一个现代化大都市里，他很富有，被大家称为“亚马孙王子”。他拥有一家每天能生产成千上万块口香糖的工厂。
一天，正当萨木制作一种全新口味的口香糖时，一场灾难发生了：装满口香糖黏胶的大桶爆炸了！滚烫的、恶心的口香糖黏胶很快蔓延到了森林、河水和土壤里，造成了严重的后果：一些蝴蝶的翅膀粘上了口香糖黏胶；食人鱼萨沙不能好好呼吸了；鳄鱼阿尔芒只要一说话，嘴里就会吐泡泡；花儿闻起来有化学黏胶的气味；一些植物的果实已经开始腐烂；没有吃的，大家都快饿死了。
看着眼前的一切，萨木羞愧地哭了起来。由于他的过失，所有人都遇到了麻烦……萨木诚恳地请求朋友们原谅自己，并表示“一定会把一切都复原的”。
在萨木的努力下，丛林重新变得干净整洁，蝴蝶们飞回来了，树上重新长出了美味的果实。森林里的小动物们高兴极了，现在的萨木才算得上是真正的“亚马孙王子”呢！

[P5] 这个故事并不复杂，但却不免引起我们对现实的思考。工业时代以来，地球环境受到了污染和破坏，环境保护已成为全人类共同面临的问题。制造污染，破坏大自然，就是毁坏人类赖以生存的家园，就是伤害我们人类自身。所以，我们应该大力提倡敬畏自然、爱护自然、与自然和谐共生的理念。

家长可以通过生活中一点一滴的小事，如植树种草，不乱扔垃圾，节约用水等，鼓励孩子逐渐成为自然的关爱者、有创造力的生活者和有责任感的环境保护者。

（全国百佳幼儿园园长 王立华）

[P6] 小猴萨米住在闪亮之城里，这是一座位于热带雨林边缘的规模宏大的现代都市。
萨米很富有，并时常为自己的富有感到骄傲，毕竟他拥有二十二台电视机、一架直升机和十二辆跑车呢！

[P7] 因此，戴着金戒指、穿着金
人字拖的萨米被大家称为“亚马
孙王子”！

[P8] 每天，萨米的口香糖工厂都会生产出成千上万块口香糖。这是巨大的成功！
这里，所有人都喜爱“萨米牌”口香糖，它有“西瓜香草”“翠竹香蕉”和“草莓红蚂蚁”三种美妙的口味。

[P10] 不过，今天上午，萨米想制作一种全新口味的口香糖，添加了柠檬水、辣椒油和蝎子油。
“这么有趣的组合，”他高兴地想，“我肯定会大获成功的！”

[P11] 可是，突然……
轰！嘣！
啪！
装满口香糖黏胶的大桶爆炸了！

口香糖
独创

[P12] 这真是一场灾难！
滚烫的、恶心的口香糖黏胶很快蔓延到了森林里。
蝴蝶们都惊慌地飞走了，但还是有一些蝴蝶的翅膀粘上了这种
奇怪的黏胶。
萨米被大桶爆炸后形成的“冲击波”冲了出去，他却站在一片
叶子上玩起了冲浪……

[P15] “不管怎样，”萨米抓着树藤边跳边想，“这也没什么大不了的……一小片森林也没什么用处嘛！最重要的是让我的工厂尽快重新开工，挽回损失。”

于是，还没处理完自己造成的污染，萨米就回到工厂准备开工了。

[P16] 萨米
口香糖

萨米终于把大桶修好啦！
由于不停地忙来忙去，萨米都快渴死了，
他想喝一大杯水！
但是，当拧开水龙头的时候，他大吃一惊。

[P17] 一股黏稠的、粉红色的液体从水管里流了出来！啊！
活像一条恶心的大虫子！

[P18] 萨米吓坏了，他决定去供水的河那边看一下到底
怎么回事。那条河通常都是很干净的呀！

[P19] 一到河边，萨米发现一部分口香糖黏胶已经流进了河里。
“太恶心了！”食人鱼萨沙嚷嚷道，“我现在都不能好好呼吸了！”

[P20] 萨米觉得很抱歉，这糟糕的状况全是他造成的。
这时，萨米又碰到了鳄鱼阿尔芒。
“呜……咕咕”阿尔芒笑着说，“刚才洗澡的时候，
我不小心喝进去了一点儿洗澡水。现在的我太滑稽
了，只要一说话，嘴里就会吐泡泡！”

咕

[P22] 阿尔芒想擤一下鼻涕，可是，一个大泡泡从他的鼻孔里冒了出来，不断地变大……
啪！
泡泡爆炸了，溅了萨米一脸！
阿尔芒被这一幕逗得哈哈大笑，马上又有十多个泡泡从他嘴里冒了出来。

[P23] 萨米吓坏了，他尖叫着跑开了。

[P24] 萨米跑得气喘吁吁的，他在一朵美丽的花儿旁边停了下来，弯下腰，想闻一闻。
“呸！怎么回事？这花儿怎么闻起来有化学黏胶的气味？”他惊讶地说道。
“答案很简单呀，”巨嘴鸟克雷蒙说道，“因为这朵花的根吸收了跑进土壤里的口香糖黏胶啊！”，

[P26] “你要知道，”克雷蒙接着说，“植物跟我们其实是一样的，也要呼吸，也要吃东西。你看这棵树，它的根部粘满了你的口香糖黏胶，果实都已经开始腐烂了！”

[P27] 这时，“咔”一声，一个烂椰子突然掉了下来，恰好砸在萨米头上。

[P28] 萨米百感交集，肚子也开始有点饿了。
但找来找去，他却找不到一丁点食物。
“我也是，我都快饿死了！”大食蚁兽奥马尔呻吟着，“我甚至连一只
能吃的红蚁都找不到。如果继续这样下去的话，我和我的家族都会被活
活饿死的！”

咕噜
咕噜

[P30] 萨米终于意识到这一切都是他造成的。
他羞愧极了，哭了起来。

[P31] “喂，到别处嚷嚷去！”树懒马修呼噜噜地埋怨道，“就算是被粘住了，我也要先睡一会儿！
“我呢，”美洲豹巴萨洋咆哮着说，“如果有人能把 我身上脏兮兮的黏胶拿下来，我会十分感激他的！”

[P32] “我的朋友们，”萨米擦干眼泪后说道，“请原谅我吧！你们让我明白了一个大道理，我们应该尊重并保护大自然！我保证会改正错误，把一切都复原的！”

[P33] 接下来的几天里，萨米一直都在卖力地清理森林……

[P35] 总算干完了，森林又重新变得干净整洁啦！
这里真是天堂呀！蝴蝶们飞回来了，树上又重新长出了美味的果实。
“干得漂亮！”小动物们欢呼着为萨米鼓掌。

[P1] Baby Emotion Management Picture Book
Learn to Take Responsibility
"Amazon Prince" Sami
[France] Pei Waker / Text
[France] Sophie Kennes / Illustrations
Dang Qiang / Translator
Times Publishing Media Co., Ltd.
Anhui Education Press

[P2] Children's Emotional Management Picture Book
Learn to Take Responsibility
"Amazon Prince" Sami
[France] Yan Vakel / Text
[France] Sophie Kennes / Illustrations
Dang Qiang / Translator
Times Publishing Media Co., Ltd.
Anhui Education Press

[P3] Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry appropriately, in the right way, toward the right person, and to the right degree—that is truly difficult.' What we now call emotional management means expressing emotions appropriately, toward the right person, and in the right way.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills. Those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack it may be intelligent but often struggle with tasks.
While emotional management skills are partly influenced by innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and development over time. Early childhood is the golden period for cultivating emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create lasting neural connections in the brain, significantly impacting a child's physical and mental development.
Currently, the method of parent-child co-reading emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness. Through parents' voices, they enter children's ears, take root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and flourish.
This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks addresses specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their emotional journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during shared reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful journey of parent-child reading together with this series!

[P4] Teacher Says to You
You can become a 'King'!
This is a vivid and exaggerated fairy tale that points out an important topic closely related to every life—environmental protection.
Little monkey Samu lives in a modern metropolis at the edge of the tropical rainforest. He is very wealthy and is called the 'Amazon Prince' by everyone. He owns a factory that produces tens of thousands of pieces of chewing gum every day.
One day, while Samu was making a new flavor of chewing gum, a disaster occurred: the large barrel filled with chewing gum adhesive exploded! The hot, disgusting adhesive quickly spread into the forest, rivers, and soil, causing serious consequences: some butterflies' wings stuck to the gum adhesive; the piranha Sasha couldn't breathe properly; the crocodile Alm would spit bubbles whenever he spoke; flowers smelled of chemical adhesive; some plants' fruits began to rot; with nothing to eat, everyone was nearly starving.
Seeing all this, Samu cried in shame. Because of his mistake, everyone was in trouble... Samu sincerely asked his friends to forgive him and promised, 'I will definitely restore everything to normal.'
With Samu's efforts, the jungle became clean and tidy again, butterflies returned, and delicious fruits grew on the trees once more. The small animals in the forest were overjoyed. Now, Samu truly deserves to be called the 'Amazon Prince'!

[P5] This story may not be complex, but it inevitably prompts us to reflect on reality. Since the industrial age, the Earth's environment has suffered pollution and destruction, making environmental protection a challenge faced by all humanity. Creating pollution and destroying nature is equivalent to destroying the home that sustains human life, and ultimately harming humanity itself. Therefore, we should strongly advocate for respecting nature, protecting nature, and living in harmony with nature.

Parents can encourage children to become caring stewards of nature, creative individuals, and responsible environmental protectors by guiding them through small daily actions, such as planting trees and grass, not littering, and conserving water.

(National Top 100 Kindergarten Principal, Wang Lihua)

[P6] Little monkey Sami lives in Shiny City, a large modern metropolis located on the edge of the tropical rainforest.
Sami is very wealthy and often feels proud of his riches, after all, he owns twenty-two televisions, one helicopter, and twelve sports cars!

[P7] Therefore, Sami, who wears gold rings and gold flip-flops, is called the 'Amazon Prince' by everyone!

[P8] Every day, Sami's gum factory produces tens of thousands of pieces of gum. This is a huge success!
Here, everyone loves "Sami Brand" gum, which comes in three delicious flavors: "Watermelon Herb," "Bamboo Banana," and "Strawberry Red Ant."

[P10] However, this morning, Sami wanted to create a brand new flavor of gum, adding lemon juice, chili oil, and scorpion oil.
"Such an interesting combination," he thought happily, "I'm sure to be a huge success!"

[P11] But suddenly...
Boom! Bang! 
Pop!
The big barrel full of gum base exploded!
Anti
Gum
Exclusive

[P12] This is truly a disaster!
Hot, disgusting gum adhesive quickly spread into the forest.
The butterflies flew away in panic, but some still had their wings stuck to this
strange adhesive.
Sami was blasted out by the "shockwave" from the explosion, but he ended up riding a wave on a leaf...

[P15] "Anyway," Sami thought, swinging from a vine, "it's not such a big deal... a small patch of forest isn't really useful anyway! The most important thing is to get my factory back up and running as soon as possible and recover my losses."

So, without even finishing cleaning up the pollution he had caused, Sami headed back to the factory to get ready to resume operations.

[P16] Sami
Gum
Original

Sami finally fixed the big barrel!
Because he kept running back and forth, Sami was almost thirsty to death,
he wanted to drink a big glass of water!
But when he turned on the faucet, he was greatly surprised.

[P17] A thick, pink liquid flowed out of the faucet! Ah!
It looked like a disgusting big bug!

[P18] Sami was terrified. He decided to go to the river that supplied water to see what was going on. That river was usually very clean!

[P19] As soon as Sami reached the riverbank, he found that some of the gum adhesive had already flowed into the river.
"This is so gross!" the piranha Sasha shouted, "I can't even breathe properly now!"

[P20] Sami felt very sorry. This terrible situation was all his fault.
At this moment, Sami ran into crocodile Armand.
"Umm... bubbly," Armand said with a smile, "When I was taking a bath earlier,
I accidentally drank a little bit of bathwater. Now I'm so silly—
whenever I speak, bubbles come out of my mouth!"

[P21] Mmm, gurgle gurgle
Gurgle
19

[P22] Armand tried to sneeze, but a big bubble came out of his nostril, growing bigger and bigger...
POP!
The bubble burst, splashing Sami's face!
Armand laughed heartily at the sight, and immediately, more than ten bubbles came out of his mouth.

[P23] Sami was terrified. He screamed and ran away.

[P24] Sami was out of breath as he ran. He stopped beside a beautiful flower, bent down, and tried to smell it.
"Ugh! What's going on? Why does this flower smell like chemical glue?" he said in surprise.
"It's very simple," said the toucan Kremo, "because the roots of this flower absorbed the chewing gum glue that ran into the soil!"

[P26] "You know," said Klemont, "plants are just like us—they need to breathe and eat. Look at this tree; its roots are covered in your chewing gum glue, and the fruits are already starting to rot!"

[P27] At this moment, with a 'crack,' a rotten coconut suddenly fell down and landed right on Sami's head.

[P28] Sami felt a mix of emotions, and his stomach began to growl with hunger.
He searched and searched, but couldn't find a single bit of food.
"Me too, I'm starving!" moaned the giant anteater Omar, "I can't even find a single
red ant to eat. If this keeps up, my family and I will starve to death!"
Gurgle
Gurgle
Gurgle

[P30] Sami finally realized that all of this was caused by him.
He felt deeply ashamed and started crying.

[P31] "Hey, go bother someone else!" the sloth Matthew grumbled, "Even if I'm stuck, I need to sleep for a while first!"
"As for me," the jaguar Basay roared, "If someone could get this dirty, sticky goo off me, I'd be very grateful!"

[P32] "My friends," Sami said after wiping away his tears, "Please forgive me! You've taught me a big lesson: we should respect and protect nature! I promise to correct my mistakes and restore everything!"

[P33] In the following days, Sami kept working hard to clean up the forest...

[P35] Finally, it's done! The forest is clean and tidy again!
This is truly paradise! Butterflies have returned, and delicious fruits are growing on the trees once more.
"Well done!" the little animals cheer, clapping for Sami.
"Sami, you truly deserve to be our 'Amazon Prince'!"

[P13] 画面中，小猴萨米站在一片巨大的绿叶上，在粉色的黏胶河流中冲浪，周围有蝴蝶和蜗牛等小动物，背景是热带雨林植物，整体呈现欢乐而奇幻的场景。
[P14] 画面中，小猴萨米倒挂在藤蔓上，面带微笑，下方是粉色的黏胶河流，周围有热带植物、水果和一只小鸟，整体呈现欢乐的森林冲浪场景。
[P15] 小猴萨米在口香糖黏胶爆炸并污染森林后，毫不在意地认为损失不大，决定立即返回工厂复工，以挽回经济损失。
[P16] 小猴萨米修好了装口香糖的大桶，因忙碌而口渴，想喝水时却突然感到震惊。
[P17] 小猴萨米想喝水时，发现水管流出黏稠的粉红色液体，他感到震惊和恶心。
[P18] 萨米发现水管流出粉红色液体后，决定前往供水的河流查看情况，因为那条河平时非常干净。
[P19] 萨米来到河边，发现口香糖黏胶已流入河中，食人鱼萨沙抱怨无法正常呼吸，表现出对污染的不满。
[P20] 萨米因口香糖污染森林而感到抱歉，他遇到了鳄鱼阿尔芒，阿尔芒因喝了被污染的洗澡水而变得滑稽，说话时嘴里会冒泡泡。
[P21] 画面中，一只绿色的鳄鱼在被粉红色黏胶污染的河水中，嘴里和身上沾满黏胶，显得滑稽又不适，周围漂浮着荷叶和黏胶块，背景是热带植物，暗示污染已蔓延至河流。
[P22] 鳄鱼阿尔芒因喝了被口香糖黏胶污染的水，鼻孔和嘴里不断冒出泡泡，他试图擤鼻涕时泡泡爆炸，溅了小猴萨米一脸，阿尔芒因此大笑不止。
[P23] 小猴萨米被鳄鱼阿尔芒喷出的泡泡溅了一脸，吓得尖叫着逃跑。
[P24] 小猴萨米在奔跑后停下，发现一朵花有化学黏胶气味，巨嘴鸟克雷蒙解释这是因为口香糖黏胶污染了土壤并被花根吸收。
[P25] 画面中，小猴萨米站在一片开满粉红色花朵的草地上，他用手捂住鼻子，表情困惑或不适；旁边一只色彩斑斓的巨嘴鸟克雷蒙站在石头上，张着嘴，似乎在解释什么。背景是热带植物和悬挂的花朵，暗示环境已被污染，花朵可能带有化学气味。
[P26] 巨嘴鸟克雷蒙向小猴萨米解释，植物也需要呼吸和进食，而口香糖黏胶污染了树根，导致果实腐烂，进一步说明污染对植物的危害。
[P27] 一个烂椰子从树上掉落，正好砸在小猴萨米的头上。
[P28] 小猴萨米感到饥饿，四处寻找食物却一无所获；大食蚁兽奥马尔也因找不到红蚁而绝望地呻吟，担心自己和家族会饿死，画面中萨米捂着肚子，背景有被粉红色黏胶污染的植物。
[P29] 画面中，一只大食蚁兽奥马尔坐在被粉红色黏胶污染的草地上，闭眼张嘴，似乎在绝望地呻吟或叹息，背景是被污染的植物和悬挂的花朵，暗示环境恶化导致其无法找到食物。

[P31] 树懒马修和美洲豹巴萨洋因被口香糖黏胶粘住而感到困扰，马修只想睡觉，巴萨洋则希望有人能帮他清除身上的黏胶。
[P32] 小猴萨米向朋友们道歉，承认自己破坏了森林环境，并承诺会改正错误、恢复自然原貌。画面中展示了清洁工具，暗示他准备开始清理工作。
[P33] 小猴萨米在接下来的几天里，卖力地清理被污染的森林，画面中他手持扫帚，正在清扫地上的粉红色黏胶。
[P34] 画面展示了一片生机勃勃的森林场景，小猴萨米坐在石头上，头顶站着一只彩色小鸟，旁边有两只粉红色火烈鸟、一条绿色蛇和一只张着嘴的鳄鱼，背景是茂密的绿植和悬挂的花朵，整体氛围和谐愉快，暗示森林环境已恢复原貌。
[P35] 森林恢复了干净整洁，蝴蝶归来，树木重新结果，小动物们为萨米鼓掌，称赞他是“亚马孙王子”，庆祝环境的重生。
[P36] 画面展示了一片宁静的森林上空，一只色彩斑斓的巨嘴鸟在飞翔，旁边有一只小蝴蝶，背景是浅蓝色的天空和几朵白云，下方是绿色的植物和橙红色的花朵，整体氛围清新自然，象征着森林环境的恢复与和谐。
